༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i srung 'khor bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i srung ba'i 'khor lo bsdus pa/bla ma dang dpal dus kyi 'kho

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i srung 'khor bsdus pa bzhugs so// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i srung ba'i 'khor lo bsdus pa/ bla ma dang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje shugs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /thugs dkyil la sogs bsdus pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu dbang bskur don/ /srung 'khor bsdus pa bshad par bya/ /'di la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum gyi/ dang po la kha lag dag pa'i cho ga sku gsung thugs ye shes sbyang ba/ lus la rigs drug dgod pa/ yan lag drug dgod pa/ yan lag drug dgod pa'i cho ga zhing skyong dang gnas bdag mchod pa/ bdag nyid rdo rje'i skur sgom pa/ bdud gzhom pa'i cho ga bgegs la phur bus gdab pa'i cho ga'o/ /dang po gnyis sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ gsum pa ni/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ las snang mtha' dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal can/ g.yas tho ba/ mdung / rtse gsum/ g.yon pad dkar 'dab brgya/ me long bgrang phreng / mgrin par āḥlas rin 'byung dmar po/ dmar dkar nag pa'i zhal can/ g.yas me'i mda'/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ sgra bcas ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gzhu/ rdo rje zhags pa/ rin chen cha dgu pa/ snying gar hūm̐ las don grub nag po/ nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ g.yas ral gri/ gri gug rtse gsum/ g.yon phub/ thod pa/ kha ṭwāṃ ga dkar po/ lte bar hoḥlas rnam snang ser po/ ser dkar nag pa'i zhal can/ g.yas 'khor lo/ dbyug pa/ rdo rje gdengs pa/ g.yon dung / lcags sgrog sgra bcas dril bu/ gtsug tor du haṃ las mi bskyod pa ljang khu/ ljang dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ g.yas rdo rje/ gri gug dgra sta/ g.yon dril bu/ thod pa/ tshangs mgo gsang bar kṣaḥlas rdor sems sngon po/ sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag mtshan snga ma dang 'dra ba bsgom mo/ /bzhi pa ni/ lag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i mthe bo gnyis kyi snying khar reg ste/ oṃ hral̥ṃ hṛ da yā ya na maḥ mgor oṃ hūṃ si ra se swā hā/ gtsug tor du oṃ hraṃ shi khā ye bau ṣaṭa/

yan lag thams cad la oṃ hṛṃ ka ba tsa ye hūṃ/ mig la oṃ hrām̐ nai tra ya ba ṣaṭa/ dge ba la g.yon/ mi dge ba la g.yas kyi mtheb mdzub kyi se gol gyis mtshon cha dgod cing / oṃ hṝḥ asatra ya phaṭa ces brjod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya si ra shi khā ka ba tsa nai tra asatra badzra ṣa ḍaṃ ga swa bhā wa ātma ko haṃ gis nga rgyal gzung ngo / /yang lte bar reg cing / oṃ hral̥ṃ nā bhyo na maḥ snying khar oṃ hṛ da yā ya swā hā/ mgrin par oṃ hraṛṃ gṝ yai bau ṣaṭa/ dpral bar oṃ hṛṃ la la ṭa ye hūm̐/ gtsug tor du oṃ hrām̐ shi khā ye ba ṣaṭa/ gsang gnas su/ oṃ hrāḥ gu hya ya phaṭa ces brjod do/ /lnga pa ni/ gtor ma gnyis 'og nas 'chad pa ltar byin gyis brlabs te 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi phyag rgyas yul bdag gam zhing skyong spyan drang zhing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ chai mo sa pa ri wā rā ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ gan dhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhū paṃ pra dī pa akṣa taṃ da dā ma he sa pa ri wā raḥ shī ghraṃ ā gatstsha tu dzaḥhuṃ baṃ hoḥ i daṃ ba li gṛṃhna tu khā da tu pi wa tu sa pa ri wā ra kaḥsarba satwo nāṃ shāntiṃ puṣṭiṃ rakṣa ā wa ra ṇa guptiṃ ka ro tu i daṃ sd+ya naṃ tyaka twā ba hyai maṇḍal bhya myāṃ tiṣṭha tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa badzra dha ra ādzñā pa ya ti swā hās gtor ma dang po zhing skyong la phul te/ chai'i gnas su yul lam grong gi ming yig mnyam pa'i thog mtha' dang mi mnyam pa'i dbus dang gsum bcug 'og ma la yang sbyar/ mthar bdud rtsis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sa 'di'i zhing skyong 'khor bcas la/ /gtor ma dri dang me tog spos/ /sgron ma 'bras bu ma nyams par/ /bcas 'di khyed la bdag 'bul gyi/ /'khor bcas myur tu byon par mdzod/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥgator ma 'di/ /bzung nas gsol zhing btung mdzad de/ /'khor dang bcas pas sems can la/ /zhi dang rgyas shing bsrung ba dang / /bskyab dang sba ba dag tu mdzod/ /gnas 'di dor nas phyi rol du/

/dkyil 'khor sa gzhi la gnas mdzod/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa rdo rje 'dzin gyis/ /ji ltar bsgo bzhin mdzod swā hā/ /'di sa bzung ba'i dus su bya ste/ gzhan du i daṃ nas tiṣṭha'i bar dor la swāsd+yā naṃ gatstsha gzhug cing / gnas 'di sogs rkang pa gnyis dor ro/ /khyi'i phyag rgyas grong dang gnas bdag spyan drang zhing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ chai mo ā gatstsha ā gatstsha shī ghraṃ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇa gṛhna bhuka twa pi twa triptiṃ kṛ twā sarba satwā na shāntiṃ tsittiṃ kṛ twā a pa rasd+yā naṃ gatstsha gatstsha swā hās gtor ma gnyis pa dbul/ bdud rtsis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ grong dang gnas bdag rnams myur du/ /tshur byon tshur byon gtor ma 'di/ /bzung zhing bzung nas gsol ba dang / /'thungs te tshim par byas nas su/ /sems can rnams ni thams cad la/ /zhi ba'i sems su byas nas ni/ /'di las gzhan pa'i gnas nyid du/ /byon zhing byon nas rgyas par mdzod/ /ces phrin las gzhol te 'di yang sa bzung ba ma yin pa'i dus su a pa rasd+yā naṃ gi gnas su sasd+yā naṃ dang / 'di sogs kyi gnas su/ rang nyid gnas pa'i gnas nyid du/ /zhes zhugs shing gshegs gsol lo/ /drug pa ni/ dpral bar zla ba la oṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse mo bcu bdun pa/ mgrin par nyi ma la āḥlas rdo rje dmar po rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ snying khar sgra gcan nag po la hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po rtse mo dgu pa/ lte bar dus me ser po la ho las rdo rje ser po rtse mo drug cu rtsa lnga pa/ /gtsug tor du nam mkha' ljang khu la rdo rje ljang khu rtse lnga pa/ gsang bar ye shes sngon po la rdo rje sngon po rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ g.yon pa'i dpung pa'i rtsa la nga ngi ngaṛ ngu ngl̥ ngaṃ/ gha ghi ghṛ ghu ghl̥ ghaṃ/ ga gi gṛ gu gl̥ gaṃ kha khi khṛ khu khl̥ khaṃ/ ka ki kṛ ku kl̥ kaṃ ste thung ngu dang / g.yas pa'i rtsa la kkāḥ kkarā kkū kkaṝ kkī kkā/

khkhāḥkhkhal̥̄ khkhū khkhaṝ khkhā/ ggāḥggal̥̄ ggū ggaṝ ggāṃ ggā ghgā+-iḥghgī ghgū ghgā+-i ghgī ghgā/ ngngāḥngangl̥̄ ngngū ngngaṝ ngngī ngngā ste ring po las rdo rje ljang khu/ nye ba'i dpung pa g.yon g.yas kyi rtsa la tsa sde thung ring las rdo rje nag po/ mkhrig ma g.yon g.yas kyi rtsa la ṭa sde thung ring las rdo rje dmar po/ dpyi g.yon g.yas kyi rtsa la pa sde thung ring las rdo rje dkar po/ pus mo g.yon g.yas kyi rtsa la ta sde thung ring las rdo rje ser po/ long bu g.yon g.yas kyi rtsa la sa sde thung ring las rdo rje sngon po ste rtse mo sum cu gnyis dang / g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung nas mthe bo'i bar gyi rtsa ba'i tshigs kyi rtsa la nga ngi ngng-i ngu ngl̥ ngaṃ dang / de bzhin du/ gha ga kha ka rnams las sbyar ba dang / g.yas kyi mthe bo nas mthe'u chung gi bar rtsa ba'i tshigs kyi rtsa la/ kkāḥkkal̥̄ kkū kkaṝ kkī kkā dang / de bzhin du/ khkhāḥsogs la sbyar ba las rdo rje ljang khu/ sor tshigs bar ma'i rtsa la tsa sde thung ring las rdo rje nag po rtse mo'i tshigs kyi rtsa la ṭa sde thung ring las rdo rje dmar mo/ rkang sor gyi rtsa ba'i tshigs kyi rtsa la pa sde thung ring las rdo rje dkar po/ bar tshigs kyi rtsa la ta sde thung ring las rdo rje ser po/ rtse mo'i tshigs kyi rtsa la sa sde thung ring las rdo rje sngon po ste/ drug cu po thams cad kyang rtse mo bdun pa'o/ /de bzhin rna ba g.yon g.yas la a ā las rdo rje ljang / sna bug g.yon g.yas la e ai las rdo rje nag mig g.yon g.yas la ar ār las rdo rje dmar/ lce lce chung la o au las rdo rje dkar/ rdo rje dang gsang ba bshang laṃ la al āl las rdo rje ser/ yid dang khu ba'i rtsa a wa dhū tī'i ya sna ma sna la aṃ āḥlas rdo rje sngon po ste rtse mo gsum pa'o/ /gtsug tor dang mgo bo la ha hā las rdo rje ljang / lce dang rkan la ya yā las rdo rje nag

lag mthil g.yon g.yas la ra rā las rdo rje dmar/ rkang mthil g.yas la wa wa las rdo rje dkar/ bshang lam gyi g.yon g.yas su la lā las rdo rje ser po rtse mo lnga pa dgod de/ de ltar bdag nyid rdo rje'i skur bsgom mo/ /bdun pa ni/ rdo rje de rnams las rang 'dra'i rdo rje rang gi kha dog dang mthun pa'i me 'bar ba ljang khu rnams ste/ sngon po 'og nag po shar shar lho/ dmar po lho lho nub/ dkar po byang byang shar/ ser po nub nub byang du spros pas phyogs bcur gnas pa'i bdud tshogs sems can la 'tshe ba rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum bsregs nas thal bar gyur par bsam zhing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ kṣaḥhraḥhraḥhraḥhraḥr ra ra ra badzra a na la sarb+ba ā wa ra ṇa dharmā pra la ya swa bhā wa sarba mā ra kā yi ga bighna bi nā ya ka a di naṃ da sha dig ga tā nāṃ kā ya wākka tsitta ni da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa bhasmi ku ru ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa ces brjod do/ /brgyad pa ni/ bdud bgegs log 'dren gzhan du bros pa dang ma tshig pa rnams rdo rje shugs kyi rdo rje lcags kyus bkug mi g.yo bas zhags pas bcings/ mtha' yas brtson 'grus kyis ha ya ra wa la thung ring las skyes pa'i rdo rje phur bu stod khro bo zhal drug phyag drug pa/ lte ba'i 'og mdung gi rtse mo'i rnam pas phyogs bcur bgegs kyi steng du btab par bsam zhing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ haṃ haṃ kṣaḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra kī la kā ya wākka tsitta dzñā na a dhi pa te ṣaṇa mu kha ṣaṭa bhu dza tsa ra nga sarba bighna bi nā ya ka a dhi duṣṭha nāṃ kā ya wākka tsitta dzñā na kī la ya kī la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces dang / de nas dbyug sngon gyi tho bas brdungs par mos te/ oṃ ll̥̄ḥbadzra mud ga ra ma ra a dī naṃ si ra si kaṇa ṭhe hri da ye/ na bhyau gu hya an te badzra kī la ya kan ā ko ṭa ya a ko ṭa ya kṣaṃ kṣāṃ kṣ-iṃ kṣā+-iṃ kṣ+r-iṃ kṣṝṃ kṣuṃ kṣūṃ kṣl̥ṃ kṣl̥̄ṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ces brjod pas bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo nas gsang ba'i bar phug gser gyi sa gzhi dang sbrags nas g.yo 'gul med cing bde ba chen po'i ror gyur pas bsam mo/

/gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ rten bskyed pa/ brten pa bskyed pa/ bzlas pa bya ba gsum gyi dang po ni/ dbus su hāṃ yāṃ raṃ wāṃ laṃ brtsegs pa bsam ste/ oṃ hāṃ yāṃ rāṃ wāṃ lāṃ badzra ā kā sha bā yu te dza u da ka pṛtha wī badzra swā bhā wa pañtsa dhā ta bo badzra maṇḍa lā ni ku ru ku ru swā hā zhes brjod pas haṃ las nam mkha'i rang bzhin chos 'byung gru gsum gyi nang du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum nor bus mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po padmas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi rdo rjes mtshan pa/ so so'i steng 'og tu hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rjes brgyan par gyur gcig tu 'dres oṃ āḥhūm̐ ra brtsegs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ra badzra tsand+ra sūrya ra hu kā la agna ye kā ya wākka tsitta dzñā na badzra prā kā rān ku ru ku ru zhes brjod pas nam mkha' dang sa 'byar ba zlum por snang ba'i mtshams nas ra ba gsum dang / yul 'khor gyi mtshams su ra ba lnga dang / dbus su rdo rje'i sa yul 'khor gyi mthar thug pa dang / 'og tu mdung dang mda'i dra ba rnon pos khyab pa'i dbus su hūm̐ bsam zhing / oṃ hūm̐ bi shwa kā ya badzra kū ṭa ga raṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas de'i dbus su khang pa brtsegs pa steng 'og tu khru nyis brgya pa'i nang du l̥ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa/ lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa khog pa stong pa'i dkyil du paḥbasam zhing / oṃ paḥbi shwa badzra padmaṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas padma 'dab brgyad khru bcu gnyis pa lte ba la khru bzhi yod pa'i steng du raḥbasam zhing / oṃ raḥbadzra sūrya ā sa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lte ba dang mnyam pa dang /

phyogs bcur nyi ma'i gdan bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa la/ dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug rdo rje dgod pa/ dbang bskur ba rgyas gdab pa/ nga rgyal gzung ba'o/ /dang po la/ bdag nyid shugs su bskyed nas nga rgyal gzung ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi sa dang slob ma bsrung phyir 'khor spro ba'o/ dang po ni/ de'i steng du bdag nyid hūm̐ dang rdo rje shugs sku mdog sngon po/ nag dmar dkar ba'i mgrin pa gsum dang / sngo dmar ser dkar ba'i zhal bzhi re re'ang mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs su rung ba dang ldan pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dmar ser du 'dug pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ g.yas g.yon gyi phrag pa dang po nag gnyis pa dmar/ gsum pa dkar ba/ kha dog de dang mtshungs pa'i dpung pa drug drug phyag nyer bzhi/ lhag ma gnyis g.yas nag g.yon ser ba/ phyag rnams kyi mthe bong ser/ mdzub mo dkar/ gung mo dmar/ ming med nag mthe'u chung ljang / sor mo rnams kyi tshigs dang po nag gnyis pa dmar/ gsum pa dkar ba/ kha dog de dang mtshungs pa'i zhabs g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar bas bdud 'dod lha dang / nyon mongs dbang phyug gi snying khar g.yas brkyang gis mnan par bsgoms la phyag rgya dgod de/ so so'i sa bon las phyag rgya so sor gyur pa bkod par bsgoms la so so'i phyag rgya bca' zhing / oṃ haṃ haḥbā ma dakṣi ṇa karṇa yor badzra kuṇḍa le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa kyis rna ba g.yon g.yas la rus pa las byas pa'i rdo rje'i rna rgyan/ de bzhin du mgor oṃ dang / mthar hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa sbyar te/ aṃ āḥkaṭyaṃ kaṇa ṭhe badzra me kha lā badzra kaṇa ṭhi kes rked mgul rgyan/ a ā bā mā dakṣi ṇa ka ra yor badzra ru tsa kaus phyag gdub/ ha hā bā ma dakṣi ṇa badzra pā da yor badzra nū pū res zhabs gdub/ haṃ baṃ pañtsa a kā ra ma hā shū n+ya swa bhā wa badzra shi ra si sarbaṃ ge bhasmas spyi bor nor bu dang lus thams cad la thal ba/

oṃ ar dha nā rī shwa ra badzwa ar dha tsand+ra badzra paṭṭa ur dhes mtshogs ma'i g.yon du zla phyed dpral bar dar dpyangs/ a āḥ.aṃ sarba swa rai ka tṛ swā bhā wa badzra ya dzñāo pa bi ta skan dhes phrag par rdo rje mchod phyir thogs bcings par bsams te/ drug ni phyin drug dag pa'o/ /de bzhin du kṣaḥdur dānda bhi mā nā kṣa yaṃ ka ra byā ghra tsar ma ka ṭaus rked par stag lpags/ haṃ kṣaḥtriṃ shwad swa ra sapta ti hra swa dīrgha byañdza na swa bhā wa dai tya ku la sha ta si ro bhir mud ḍa ma la skan dha ā ba laṃ bi ni skan dhes phrag par bdud rigs brgya'i mgo phreng / ha hi hṛ hu hl̥ pañtsa skan dha bi shuddhā swa bhā we shi ra si ka pā la mā les dbu re re la thod pa rdzogs pa kha dog lnga'i phreng ba ste/ glang lpags dang bcas pa bzhis phar phyin phyi ma dag pa ste/ gnas kyi dbye bas bcu drug ni stong nyid bcu drug dag pa'o/ /de bzhin du g.yas kyi phyag dang po bzhir/ oṃ kṣ+raḥbadzra kro dha badzra hūm̐ phaṭa kyis khro bo'i rdo rje de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ tri shū la rtse gsum/ karta ris gri gug dmar po bzhir bā ṇas mda'/ aṃ ku shas lcags kyu/ ḍa ma ru kas ḍa ma ru/ mud ga ras tho ba/ dkar po bzhir/ tsakras 'khor lo/ kun tas mdung / daṇa ḍas dbyug pa/ par shus dgra sta/ g.yon gyi nag po bzhir/ oṃ hwaṃ badzra ghaṇḍe hoḥphreṃ phaṭa kyis rdo rje dril bu/ de bzhin sbyar/ khe ṭa hos phub/ kha ṭwaṃ gas kha ṭwāṃ ga ka pā las thod pa/ dmar po bzhir/ tsā pas gzhu/ pa shas zhags/ ratnas rin po che/ padmas padma/ dkar po bzhir shaṃ khas dung / ā dar shas me long / shriṃ kha lāes lcags sgrog tsa tur be da swa bhā brahma shi raṃ gis tshangs mgo gdong bzhi pa/ oṃ kṣa kṣa kṣi kṣī kṣ+r-i kṣṝ kṣu kṣū kṣl̥ kṣl̥̄ kṣaṃ kṣaḥ ha hā hi hī hṛ hṛ hu hū hl̥ hl̥ haṃ haḥ sarba bighna bi da ri ta ga dza tsar ma pa ṭa a tra rakta shra bta hūm̐ phreṃ gis glang lpags rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa mgo g.yas su bstan te gyon pa'i rkang lag gnyis nas phyag tha ma gnyis kyis gzung ste 'phyar zhing sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/

oṃ hūm̐ badzra dza ya nā gend+ra badzra dza ḍa mu ku ṭa ban dhe tiṣṭha tiṣṭha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa kyis rgyal ba ljang khus ral pa la cod pan/ de bzhin du mgor oṃ dang / mthar tiṣṭha sogs sbyar te/ kṣuṃ badzra bi dza ya nā gend+ra badzra paṭṭas rnam rgyal sngon pos dar dpyangs/ hlaṃ hlāṃ badzra karko ṭa ka badzra padmo bā ma dakṣi ṇa kuṇḍa la yoḥs stobs rgyu dang padma nag pos g.yon g.yas kyi rna rgyan/ hraṃ hra badzra bā su ki shaṃ khā pā lau bā ma dakṣi ṇa ru tsa ka yoḥs nor rgyas dang dung skyong dmar pos g.yon g.yas kyi phyag gdub/ hwaṃ hwaṃ badzra ananta ku le ka me khā lā kaṇa ṭhi ka yoḥs mtha' yas dang rigs ldan dkar pos ska rags mgul rgyan/ hlaṃ hlaṃ badzra takṣa ko ma hā pad mau bā ma dakṣi ṇa pā da nu pu ra yoḥs 'jog po dang pad chen ser pos g.yon g.yas kyi rkang gdub tu bcings par mos la/ oṃ hūm̐ kro dhen dro haṃ kro dha naṃ adzñā da ya ka swā hās nga rgyal gzung ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ snying kha'i nyi mar/ hya yyā rarā wwā llā brtsegs pa'i ha dang rdo rje las/ gtsug tor ljang khu mi bskyod pa dang / hā dang rdo rje las gnod mdzes rdor sems lta bur gyur pa/ oṃ haṃ badzra kro dha rā dza ma hā uṣṇi ṣa ur dha di shi rakṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā oṃ haḥbadzra kro dha rā dza su mbha ā dho di shi rakṣaṃ ku ru ku ra swā hās/ bka' bsgos nas/ rtsa zhal gyi rna ba g.yon g.yas nas phyung / steng 'og gi rtsibs su nyi mar 'khod/ de bzhin du sngags kyi mtha' thog sbyar zhing / yi yī dang ral gri las bgegs mthar byed dang dbyug sngon don grub lta bur gyur/ yaṃ badzra kro dha rā dza a dhi ba la sarba bighnan ta ka pūrba dang / yāḥbadzra kro dha rā dza nī la daṇḍa agne yaṃ gis bka' bsgos/ sna g.yon g.yas nas phyung / shar dang mer nyi mar 'khod/ ṛ ṝ da rin chen las shes rab mthar byed dang 'dod rgyal rin 'byung lta bur gyur/

raṃ badzra kro dha rā dza dzambha ka duṣṭa pra dzñā na ta ka dakṣi ṇa dang / raḥbadzra kro dha rā dza ṭakki n+ye ri tyaṃ gis bka' bsgos mig g.yon g.yas nas phyung / lho dang bden bral du nyi mar 'khod/ wu wū dang padma las padma mthar byed dang mi g.yo ba snang mtha' lta bur gyur/ waṃ badzra kro dha rā dza man ka bi ra ga padmā na ta ka utta ra dang / waḥbadzra kro dha rā dza a tsa la ī shwa nas bka' bsgos/ lce dang chu lam nas phyung / /byang dang dbang ldan du nyi mar 'khod/ l̥ l̥̄ dang 'khor lo las gshin rje mthar byed/ stobs po che snang mtha' lta bur gyur/ laṃ badzra kro dhā rā dza stambha ka ya mānta ka ya pashtsi mas dang / laḥbadzra kro dha rā dza ma hā bā la bā ya byaṃ gis bka' bsgos/ bshang lam dang gtsug tor nas phyung / nub dang rlung du nyi mar 'khod/ thams cad kyang skra dmar ser gyis rgyan du brdzes pa/ sbrul dang phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum pa/ g.yas brkyang gis gnas pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang dzaḥzhes brjod/ rang las rang 'dra spros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs rang la bstims te mchod/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya dang hūm̐ gis shes rab mthar byed kyis gzhug zhags pa'i phyag rgya dang baṃ gyis gshin rje mthar byed kyis dbyer med du bcing / dril bu'i phyag rgya dang hos padma mthar byed kyis mnyes par byas/ dbyug pa'i phyag rgya dang his bgegs mthar byed kyis ro mnyam par byas par bsam mo/ /gsum pa ni sngar ltar rdo rje'i sa bon rnams 'god pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ sgrub thabs ltar dbang bskur rgyas par blang bar bya'o/ /lnga pa ni/ gtso bo dang gtsug tor la mi bskyod pa/ bgegs mthar byed dang / dbyug sngon la don grub shes rab mthar byed dang 'dod rgyal la rin 'byung / padma mthar byed dang mi g.yo ba la snang mtha'/ gshin rje mthar byed dang stobs po che la rnam snang /

gnod mdzes la rdor sems rnams sprul sku'i cha byad can gyis dbu rgyan par bsam mo/ /drug pa ni/ oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta rakṣaṃ tsakra swa bhā wa atma ko haṃ gis nga rgyal bzung bar bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ snying kha'i nyi mar rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ la sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyud bskul/ byin rlabs 'od kyi rnam par bsdus/ sngags phreng la thim/ 'od phyogs bcur 'phros/ bdud bgegs thams cad tshar bcad par bsam zhing / sngags don dran bzhin pas/ oṃ na mo badzra satwa ya/ na mo buddha bo dhi satwe bhyaḥ na mo badzra kro dhend+ra rā dze bhyaḥ na mo bi shwa mā tre/ na mo buddha bo dhi satwa de wī bhyaḥn mo badza ḍā ki nī bhyaḥ.aṃ na mo bha ga wā te kā la tsa krā ya/ badzra bhair wa bhī ka rā ya ma hā ind+ra nī la warna sha ri rā ya/ mā ra kle sha hri da ya krān ta si ta rakta tsa ra ṇā ya/ kṛṣṇa rakta si ta kaṇa ṭhā ya/ nī la si ta pī ta rakta daṃṣṭ+ra ka ra lo gra bhīṣa ṇa mu khā ya/ kṛṣṇa rakta si ta sa bye ta raskan dhā ya/ dwa da sha bhū dzā ya/ ṣaṭa biṃ sha ti ka rā ya/ badzra khaṭa ga tri shū la/ karti ka bā na/ aṃ ku sha ḍa ma ru ka mud ga ra/ tsakra/ kun ta/ daṇḍa par shu/ badzra ghaṇa ṭā/ khe ṭa/ kha ṭwaṃ ga ka pā la/ tsā pa/ pā sha ratna/ ka ma la/ shaṃ kha/ ā ngarsha/ shrīṃ kha lā/ brahma shi ro/ ga dza tsarma dh-i ka ka ra ya/ byā ghra tsarma ni wa sa nā ya/ skan dhe muṇḍa mā la a ba laṃ bi ne/ shi ra si badzra paṭṭa/ mu ku ṭe/ badzra ka pā la mā la/ ar dha tsand+ra rā ya/ kuṇḍa la/ ru tsa ka kan ṭhi ka me kha la/ nū pu ra/ bhasma yadzño pa bī ta/ shi ro ma ṇi/ ma hā mu dra/ nā gend+ra/ bi bhu ṣa ṇa ya/ badzra ḍā ki ni santo shi ta hri da yā ya/ ind+ra agni ya ma nai ritya ba ru ṇa bā yu ku be ra ī sha na brahma biṣṇu bi nā ya ka kārti ke ya nan ti ma hā kā la gra ha nakṣe tra kṣe tra pa la su rend+ra a su rend+ra pha ṇīnd+ra bhu tend+ra na rend+ra saṃ tu ta tsa ra ṇā ya/

zhes rkang pa bcu drug pa dang / sngar gyi bka' bsgo ba'i sngags bzlas so/ /gsum pa rjes la mchod pa/ bstod pa/ gtor ma/ gshegs gsol bzhi'i dang po ni/ sgrub thabs ltar mchod rdzas bsangs sbyangs/ chu gnyis dang lha mo bcu gnyis dang bdud rtsis mchod pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ /dpa' bo gdul dka' 'dul ba po/ /dus kyi 'khor lo thod pa can/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ /rje bo sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin/ /khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyi gtso/ /zhabs la srid gsum gyis bstod pa/ /rdo rje'i shugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ha ya ra wa la las skyes/ /rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal po che/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams rnams gnas nas/ /phyogs bcu srung mdzad rnams la 'dud/ /ces pas bstod do/ /gsum pa ni/ ji ltar 'byor ba'i gtor ma gcig drug bdun la sogs pa sgrub thabs ltar bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po me 'bar ba'i steng du āḥlas bum pa bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ rāḥlas thod pa dum bu gcig pa'i nang du padma 'dab ma brgyad la/ a i ṛ u l̥ las dbus su khu ba/ shar du rkang / lhor khrag byang du dri chu/ nub tu bshang ba/ l̥̄ ū ṝ ī ā las rlung du glang po'i sha dbang ldan du ba lang / srin por rta/ mer khyi/ dbus su mi'i sha rnams sa bon de dag gis mtshan pa bsams la/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis bskul ba'i rlung gis me sbar te zhu ba'i dam tshig gi bdud rtsi nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog lta bur gyur/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du zla ba la oṃ bsams pa gtor ma la bstan te/ oṃ oṃ badzra tsand+ra sarba dharma su bi shuddha ཿsā bhā wa sarba dharman bi sho dha ya swā hā/ zhes brjod pas oṃ las 'od 'phros bdud rtsi la phog pas mi gtsang ba'i dri ma sbyangs/

lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du nyi ma la āḥbasams pa bstan te/ oṃ āḥbadzra sūrya sarba dharmā sarba dharmā pra bo dha ka sarba dharmān pra bo dha ya swā hā/ zhes brjod pas aḥlas 'phros pa phog pa bdud rtsi chags pa'i ro dang ldan par rtogs par bsam/ lag pa gnyis ka kha sbub pa'i snyim par sgra gcan la hūm̐ bsams pa bstan te/ oṃ hūm̐ badzra a na la sarba pra dī pa ka sarba dharman pra bo dha ya swā hā/ zhes brjod pas hūm̐ las 'phros pa'i 'od phog pas mang por spel te gzi brjid rab tu 'bar zhing kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs par bsam/ mkha' lding gi phyag rgya bcas pa'i steng du dus me'i steng du hoḥbasams bstan te/ oṃ ho sarba dharmā badzra a mṛ ta ka ra sarba dharmā na badzra a mṛ taṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod pas ho las 'phros pa'i 'od kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug pa thim pas zag bcas kyi dri ma sbyangs nas zag med kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsam/ de nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas gtor ma'i mdun du spyan drangs nas gsol bar bsam zhing / gtso bo la oṃ aḥhūm̐ hoḥshri kā la tsakra/ badzra bhai ra ba bhyaḥ sa pā ri wā re bhyaḥ.i daṃ ba liṃ gan dhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhū paṃ dī paṃ a kṣa taṃ da dā ma he te dza a gatya sa pa ri wā ra shi ghraṃ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇantu/ khā dantu pi wantu dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho saṃ triptāḥsarba satwa naṃ puṣṭiṃ puṣṭiṃ rakṣa ā wa ra ṇa guptiṃ kurban tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa badzra dha ra ādzñā pa ya ti swā hā dang / khro bo la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ.uṣṇi ṣa/ sumbha ni sumbha/ bighnan ta ka nī la daṇḍa/ pradzñānta ka ṭakki rā dza/ padmān ta ka a tsa la/ ya mān ta ka ma hā bā le bhyaḥs pa ri wā ra sogs kyis dbul/ lha mo bcu gnyis dang bdud rtsis mchod/ /dus kyi 'khor lo thod pa can/ /khro bo'i rgyal po 'khor bcas la/ /gtor ma dri dang me tog spos/ /sgron ma ma nyams 'bras bcas 'di/

/bdag gis 'bul gyis khyed rnams kyang / /'khor dang bcas pa myur gshegs nas/ /gtor ma 'di ni bsnams nas kyang / /gsol zhing btung bar mdzad nas su/ /yang dag mnyes pa sems can kun/ /zhi dang rgyas dang bsrung ba dang / /sba ba rnams ni mdzad pa dang / /rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin mdzod/ /ces pas phrin las bcol lo/ /bzhi pa ni/ yi ge kṣa dang lag pa'i rgyab bstan pa'i se gol gyis gsang gnas kyi 'khor lor haṃ la khro bo rnams gshegs su gsol lo/ /dkyil chog gi dus su thun mtshams gsum du gtor ma sbyin pa'i tshul yang 'di nyid de/ 'di'i rjes la sa bzung ba la sogs pa bya'o/ /thugs dkyil sogs su dbang bskur ba'i/ /sa gzhi yongs bzung dus nyid du/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa'i tshul/ /bkod pa'i dge bas sangs rgyas shog /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i srung 'khor bsdus pa/ bla ma ye shes dbang phyug gis bskul ba'i ngor/ a wa dhū tī pa bsod nams kyis/ sna tshogs dbyig gi lo smal po'i zla ba'i yar tshes brgyad la rdzogs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rgyal mtshan bzang po'o/ /'dis bdud thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 12 bla ma dam pa/ dus 'khor gyi srung 'khor bsdus pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 11
